content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Guides gumroad

Each option has its own set of features and limitations. Gumroad, for example, offers a simple way to sell digital products, but it comes with a 3.5% + $0.30 per sale transaction fee and a 30-day waiting period before you can access funds. Stripe, on the other hand, provides a robust payment processing solution, but it's only available in 46 countries. PayPal is even more restrictive, with a suspended account potentially holding funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) — Stack 02 deployed in 48 hours, Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments — offers a complete combination of free and paid tools that give you a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Stripe are not available in many countries, including Nepal, Somalia, and several African nations. PayPal is also restricted in several countries, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure is not bound by these restrictions, as it's based on open-source technology and decentralized payment processing, allowing you to sell digital products to customers worldwide without relying on platforms that can be restrictive.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad and Stripe charge transaction fees, with Gumroad's fee being 3.5% + $0.30 per sale and Stripe's fee being 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. PayPal's fees are also high, with a 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction fee. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure like NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee, making it a more cost-effective option for creators and sellers. Furthermore, with NOWPayments, you don't have to worry about payment processing delays or holdups, as funds are transferred directly to your account upon confirmation of the on-chain payment.
A sovereign commerce infrastructure like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is the permanent structural alternative to Gumroad, Stripe, and PayPal.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When you use Gumroad or Stripe, you're not in full control of your digital products and payment processing. With Gumroad, you have to wait 30 days to access funds, and with Stripe, you're still dependent on their payment processing solution. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) gives you full ownership and control over your digital products and payment processing, allowing you to automate delivery and setup instant payment processing with NOWPayments. This means you can focus on growing your business without worrying about payment processing or delivery issues.
